title: A plan for a generic engine core
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: An accepted decision record (ADR-014) gives the engine a generic core: the engine keeps the fixed tick, seeded randomness, hashes and replays, and runs a game through a rules interface. Only that first step is approved, with the tank rules staying in the engine and every match hash and replay byte-identical. Moving the tank rules to the Tank Arena crate waits until a second Rust game exists, which may never happen. No code has changed yet.
next: the generic core starts once the tank rules (rules-v1) merge.
